chapter: Chapter VIII: L² Estimates on Pseudoconvex Manifolds

examples.title: Hormander L² Estimate
examples.content: On a pseudoconvex domain with weight function phi, the dbar equation has L² solutions with controlled norm.

examples.title: Bochner-Kodaira Identity
examples.content: The fundamental identity relating the dbar-Laplacian to curvature and torsion terms.

simulator.title: Pseudoconvex Domain
simulator.description: The domain {|z|^2 < 1} is strictly pseudoconvex with defining function r = |z|^2 - 1.

applications.title: Several Complex Variables
applications.description: L² methods solve the dbar equation and prove extension theorems.

applications.title: Algebraic Geometry
applications.description: L² estimates provide effective versions of vanishing and extension theorems.

concepts.name: Pseudoconvex Domain
concepts.definition: A domain Omega where -log d(z, boundary) is plurisubharmonic near the boundary.

concepts.name: Multiplier Ideal Sheaf
concepts.definition: The sheaf I(phi) of germs f with |f|^2 e^{-phi} locally integrable.

exercises.question: Show that the unit ball in C^n is strictly pseudoconvex.
exercises.hint: Compute the Levi form of the defining function r = |z|^2 - 1.

exercises.question: Prove that L² holomorphic functions on a bounded pseudoconvex domain form a Hilbert space.
exercises.hint: Show completeness using the mean value property and L² estimates.

diagrams.title: Levi Form Visualization
diagrams.description: The Levi form measures convexity of the boundary in complex tangential directions.
diagrams.instructions: Positive Levi form indicates the domain curves away from the boundary.
